newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded again, bids and offers far apart.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded again, bids and offers far apart.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Tuesday, with both bids and offers only seen on seven of the contract's 12 months at the close of trade.
In January, February and March of next year, bids and offers were a full penny a therm apart, far wider than normal during an active session.
Front month June saw the tightest range, with a bid at 11.20 pence against an offer at 11.60 pence, compared with a settlement level of 11.45 pence on Friday.
But the next three months saw wider ranges again, with July, August and September all bid at 11.00 pence and offered at 11.60 pence.
A spokeswoman for the IPE said that the exchange was not surprised by the lack of futures trade given that the OTC market had also been extremely quiet on Tuesday.
